verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents its own bank connection: it merges your business account with bookkeeping, supports over 4,000 banks and neobanks, and maps invoices to bank payments. That covers the core bank-linking part of the story. The evidence never mentions credit-card accounts, and it does not say transactions import automatically on a daily or recurring schedule. Missing for 10: credit-card account connection, evidence of automatic daily transaction import, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: Seamlessly merge your business account and bookkeeping and pay your invoices directly from sevdesk. We already support over 4,000 banks and neobanks.
Map invoices directly to your bank payments.
